Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
We are looking for a Commercial Sales Engineer to join our East team. This is a remote role, reporting to the Manager of Sales Engineering. The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security. Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world. 

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• 

Create and deliver technical product presentations to prospective customers

• 

Gather customer technical requirements to ensure proposed solutions will meet customer goals and needs

• 

Lead product evaluations and custom product configurations

• 

Design evaluation test plans with customers and guide the process to successful outcomes

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• 

You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• 

You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• 

You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and never stop developing yourself, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

• 

You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems. You champion their needs from start to finish, knowing their success is our success.

• 

You champion simplicity. You are skilled at distilling complex problems, user needs, and technical concepts into clear, simple, and actionable plans. You are a precise communicator who brings clarity and focus to every interaction.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

• 

Proven cybersecurity and networking technical background with hands-on experience in network fundamentals such as TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, and firewalls

• 

2+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or Network Systems integrator

• 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent working experience

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• 

Technical certifications such as CCNA, Network+, CCNP, CCIE, or Security+

• 

Prior experience closing deals in a quota-carrying role

• 

Experience running multiple POVs in tandem and working with small to medium-sized business or enterprise accounts in the networking or cybersecurity space

• Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs.

At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Anaplan is seeking a Solution Architect to join our Professional Services team in Germany—a group of expert consultants who are passionate about delivering real, measurable value through Anaplan’s cutting-edge planning platform.

As a key member of our Professional Services team, you won’t just be implementing solutions, you’ll shape the future of enterprise planning for our most strategic customers. This team partners closely with stakeholders across Finance, Supply Chain, and Sales Performance Management to solve complex business challenges with smart, scalable solutions. From the very first engagement, you’ll have the opportunity to lead design, delivery, and strategic advisory work that drives transformation at the enterprise level.

As we drive financial transformation, you will be a key player in architecting the future direction of decision excellence in enterprise grade companies across Germany. You will influence and drive a companies planning direction and play a pivotal role in delivering the outcomes the CFO, CIO and CEO need to take their business to the next level. 

We’re known for collaboration, deep expertise, and ability to unlock the full potential of Anaplan’s powerful connected planning platform. You’ll work with Anaplan’s industry-leading Hyperblock™ technology that delivers real-time data capabilities, and best in class planning and modelling capabilities. Grow your own skills while helping customers outpace disruption and outperform the competition—by planning smarter, faster, and more effectively.

Your Role

As an Architect, you are responsible for the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in some of our most important strategic accounts. 

  • Serve as the Architectural SME for large-scale connected planning solutions.
  • design ownership across engagements, acting as design authority towards customers and partners, and solution review and quality assurance.
  • Work with customer teams to transform and optimise business process through the Anaplan Platform.
  • Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi-dimensional models.
  • Support scoping, estimations and customer presentations as part of a solution sales process.
  • Assist with knowledge management, mentoring and enablement across the Professional Services Teams.

Your Qualifications

We’re looking for smart, consultative professionals who love solving problems, building relationships, and pushing boundaries. We want you to bring your vision, experience, and passion to our team – helping our customers to out-predict, out-plan and outperform their competitors. 

  • 3+ years of experience implementing planning or EPM solutions in a customer-facing context (consulting, Professional Services or partner).
  • Hands-on modeling in a multidimensional planning tool. Anaplan is ideal, but experience with TM1, OneStream, Pigment, Board, Jedox or similar is a valid basis.
  • Solid understanding of planning processes in finance (FP&A), supply chain (e.g. S&OP, demand and supply planning), sales or workforce planning
  • Experience running workshops, gathering requirements, presenting solution design.
  • German (C1 or higher) and fluent business English.
  • Willingness to travel within DACH.
  • Ability to work remote and independently.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   

Privacy & AI Notice

4a3d8959c4ba0f97.description: Sit with the companies building on Isomorph, ship the software their teams run on, and make it work for every customer after them. ## The role Our first enterprise customers are finance and operations teams, buried in work no software ever covered: reconciliations, approvals, payouts, reports stitched together from spreadsheets and email. Their own people are now building apps and agents for that work with AI. Some get them live in a day. Others get stuck on a messy system, a missing connection, or a question nobody at their company can answer. You will be the engineer who sits with them. You will work closely with about three early customers, learn how their teams really work, build and ship their apps and agents on Isomorph, and connect them to the systems they already depend on. You will be based in Bengaluru, often at their offices, and everything you learn there comes back into the product. ## What you'll own - The apps and agents your customers depend on, from the first conversation to running in production. - Connections into the systems they run on: spreadsheets, email, ERP, accounting and HR systems, databases and APIs. - Getting the builders at your customers unstuck, fast, and showing them what is possible. - The trust of each customer's business teams and their IT, as the person who gets it done. - Turning what you see in the field into product changes, so the next customer gets it for free. ## What you'll get to build next - Turn the patterns you see across customers into ready-made connectors, agents and playbooks that every Isomorph customer can use. - Get to a world where a new customer goes from first call to apps in production in days, mostly without needing us. - Shape how forward deployed engineering works at Isomorph as the team grows. ## You'll thrive here if - You have 2-6 years of building and shipping real software, and some of that time was in front of customers. - You have tamed messy business systems (ERPs, accounting or HR tools, old databases, flaky APIs) and made them reliable. - You live in AI coding agents and can put a working app in front of someone the same day. - You can sit with a finance lead or an IT head, understand the real problem, and explain the fix in plain words. - You take ownership: when a customer is stuck, it is your problem until it is solved, and then you make sure it never happens again. ## Why Isomorph For fifty years, software inside a company has been written by a small group of engineers, for everyone else. That is ending. With AI, the people who know the work best (the finance analyst, the ops lead, the recruiter, the support manager) can now build the software they need themselves. Most of them have never written a line of code. This is one of the biggest shifts in how companies work, and it has a missing piece. The software these people build is useful, and very often unsafe: no sign-in, sensitive data exposed, nobody to run it, and invisible to IT. Multiply that across a large company and you get thousands of apps and agents that nobody governs. Isomorph is the foundation that software runs on. Bring an app or agent built with any AI tool, and Isomorph runs it on the company's own cloud: secured, connected to company data and systems, monitored and kept healthy. Builders never think about infrastructure. IT stays in control of everything. We believe every company will become AI-native one workflow at a time, built by its own people. Isomorph is where that software will live. The team. You will join a small, high-talent-density founding team from IIT Madras and IIT Delhi. The founders are second-time founders who have built companies before and sold one. ## Why you'll love it here - You'll be early. You will be one of the first people on the team, with real ownership and a real say in what Isomorph becomes. - You'll work at the frontier. AI agents and enterprise-grade infrastructure, applied to a problem every company is about to have. - You'll see your impact. We work side by side with customers, so what you ship is in real people's hands within days. - You'll build the way the future builds. We build Isomorph with AI agents ourselves, so your leverage is your judgment and your taste, not your typing speed. - You'll grow fast. Small team, huge surface, founders who have built and scaled before.

About Prove 

As the world moves to a mobile-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers. Prove’s phone-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction, enhance security and privacy across all digital channels, and accelerate revenues while reducing operating expenses and fraud losses. Over 1,000 enterprise customers use Prove’s platform to process 20 billion customer requests annually across industries, including banking, lending, healthcare, gaming, crypto, e-commerce, marketplaces, and payments. For the latest updates from Prove, follow us on LinkedIn.

Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self-starting professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together.   

Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team! 

Title: Strategic Sales Director

Department: Revenue

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Bay Area, CA preferred 

The Strategic Sales Director will have a hunter mentality and experience selling digital identity verification solutions into top tier global accounts, with success in winning net new logos.  

Responsibilities:

• Become a trusted partner selling Prove solutions that meet/exceed the business needs of the client/prospect. 

• Exceed annual sales quotas of Annual Contract Value (ACV), Annual Guaranteed Value (AGV) and in year revenue growth.  

• Build and maintain relationships with enterprise level clients, understanding the organization's strategic initiatives in digital identity and authentication as well as a deep knowledge of the prospect’s organizational structure and decision/buying process.

• Develop a deep knowledge of how Prove solutions meet the client/prospect's use cases.

• Exhibit a strong passion for continued learning about our products and markets through in-house and external training experiences.

• Independently build and manage your direct sales pipeline in assigned accounts and/or a geographic region.

• Define and execute sales strategy for AI players.

• Conduct discovery sessions to clearly understand the prospect's business needs, priorities, budget, timing and key KPIs.

• Translate data study results to executive summaries that clearly articulate Prove value and ROI. 

• Prepare prospect proposals, negotiate business terms and manage the overall contractual process with limited oversight.

• Leverage cross functional resources and teammates effectively and efficiently to drive sales process through effective communication and manage through expectations setting.

• Utilize internal resources efficiently and effectively to drive the sales process with clear thought leadership.

• Promote, maintain and enhance our cultural values of humility, passion, inclusion, and leadership

Experience:

• Strong history of quota attainment.

• Extensive quota-carrying experience in an Enterprise or strategic sales role with complex selling cycles; SaaS based solutions preferred; strong track record of closing enterprise-level deals over $1M in ACV/AGV/ARR.  

• Experience and relationships with big tech, AI, large payments, digital marketplaces and e-commerce accounts.

• Proven consultation skills with the ability to influence at all levels of leadership.

• Executive presence with polished interpersonal style, excellent verbal and written communication skills and high emotional intelligence.

• Sales hunter mentality and an entrepreneurial spirit.

• Possesses the ability to communicate simply, articulately while exuding confidence and humility; the ability to tell a compelling business story, deeply understand the prospects business goals and lead a sales process.

• Desire to understand and communicate the underlying technology to business prospects.

• Understanding of the identity verification ecosystem with a focus on Identity.

• Strong prospecting, qualifying, and negotiating skills; consultative sales approach with a business solution centric mindset.

• A self-starter. Need to have a roll up your sleeves mentality with an ability to work independently in a fast paced, high-growth environment.

About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
What You'll Do

• Architecture & strategy

• Define security architecture for Flexport's products and services, and set the patterns and reference implementations that make secure-by-default the path of least resistance.

• Lead security engineering reviews for the highest-risk product features, and set the bar for what "good" looks like in reviews you don't personally run.

• Build and scale the security champions program and product security training that extend your judgment into teams where you can't be in every review.

• Design-time & review

• Lead domain-specific threat modeling and attack surface analysis across Flexport's product surface, not just individual features.

• Partner with engineering leadership to resolve the design tradeoffs that a senior engineer would escalate.

• Vulnerability management

• Set the bar for how the team triages, reproduces, and prioritizes bug bounty submissions and internal security reports, and step in on the hardest or highest-severity cases.

• Drive remediation of systemic classes of vulnerability, not just individual findings.

• Developer enablement & leadership

• Own the security services and tooling consumed by product teams across our global infrastructure.

• Mentor other engineers on the team, and act as the authoritative technical voice on product security across engineering leadership.

You Should Have

• Typically 2–5 years of experience in product/application security or software development with a security focus — we care more about what you've built than the exact number. If you meet most of this, apply; we'd rather see your work than filter you out on a résumé line.

• Strong grasp of web application security principles and common attack vectors (e.g., OWASP Top 10)

• Proficiency with application testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or browser developer tools

• Working knowledge of at least one modern programming language (e.g., Ruby, Java/Kotlin, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python) and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure)

• Comfortable with security on-call rotation and picking up work across security disciplines when needed

Nice to Have

• Hands-on experience with bug bounty platforms

• Hands-on experience with SAST tools (Cycode, Semgrep, Snyk, or similar)

• Experience with cloud infrastructure security and container technologies

• Participation in CTF events or open-source security projects

• Familiarity with threat modeling frameworks and secure SDLC best practices

• Interest in contributing to internal developer security training programs

How We Work

• We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs

• We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one

• We're agile, but not dogmatic — the team decides how it works best

Why This Role Is Special

• Massive leverage: the conventions and champions program you build are multiplied across hundreds of engineers who never talk to you directly.

• Broad authority: you set the architecture other reviews are measured against, rather than being the one measured.

• You're part of PSI: the platform, security, and infrastructure teams work hand in hand, and security is treated as infrastructure with real engineering quality bars, not a policy function.

About Contra Labs

Contra Labs sits at the intersection of human creativity and AI. We partner with leading AI labs and product companies to improve their tools across design, video, development, and beyond. Our research is grounded in how top creatives actually work, studying the patterns behind what gets created, what gets chosen, and what resonates. We believe human input will always be at the center of net new creation, and our mission is to help shape technology so human creativity can be amplified to create what today is unimaginable.

By joining the Contra Labs network you gain access to paid projects with some of the most innovative companies building the next generation of creative and AI-powered tools.

How It Works

This is an application to join the network and be eligible for roles as they arise. Projects are staffed on an as-needed basis, typically 5 to 10 hours at a time, though some may extend into longer engagements. In unique cases, we may have full-time roles available as well. When a project matches your skill set, we'll reach out with details and timeline.

To Join the Network

• 

Portfolio review - We'll assess your Contra profile and portfolio for strength in content design, with a focus on ad creative and performance-driven visual content.

• 

Record a 30 second intro video - Share a quick 30 second introduction so we can get to know you.

• 

Complete profile - Once you’ve applied, we recommend completing your profile for better job matches and setting up your wallet so you can get paid when a job comes through.

What You May Work On

• 

Evaluate AI-generated 3D scenes, interactive environments, simulations, and spatial experiences for visual and technical quality

• 

Provide clear, structured feedback on scene composition, lighting, materials, physical dynamics, asset integration, interaction, and overall visual coherence

• 

Help define quality benchmarks and evaluation criteria for what great AI-generated 3D experiences should look and feel like

• 

Identify common failure modes in AI-generated 3D work, from broken physics and interactions to poor spatial composition or inconsistent visual feedback

• 

Create reference examples, prototypes, or "golden" outputs that demonstrate best-in-class 3D execution

• 

Contribute to research exploring how AI models can better understand and generate interactive 3D experiences

What We're Looking For

• Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality 3D design, interactive environments, or spatial experiences

• 

Strong understanding of 3D composition, lighting, materials, animation, and visual coherence

• 

Ability to articulate creative and technical feedback clearly and constructively

• 

Strong 3D design instincts and awareness of contemporary visual culture, 3D trends, and emerging digital aesthetics

• 

Comfort working in fast-paced, experimental environments (experience with AI, 3D tools, or creative technology is a plus)

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/contra-senior-3d-designer
